descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X1 Tri-Mode Wireless Flagship Gaming Mouse with Touchpad RGB Charging Dock and Premium Grip Tape Bundle - Black Edition

Dominate your competitive esports matches and unlock pixel-perfect tracking velocity with the ultra-premium Attack Shark X1 Tri-Mode Wireless Flagship Gaming Mouse in Matte Black, packaged directly with high-traction protective custom Grip Tape. Available at Turbo Computer, this state-of-the-art PC hardware gaming peripheral is masterfully engineered for elite competitive players, pro-tier FPS athletes, and digital workspace managers across Egypt who demand flawless absolute tracking control, zero latency, and the lighter footprint of a 53-gram weapon. Equipped with unrivaled flagship tracking sensor specifications including extreme DPI resolution control and lightning-fast IPS velocity thresholds, this mouse comes backed by an official 1-year warranty.

The crown jewel of the Attack Shark X1 framework is the inclusion of the upgraded Magnetic Touchpad RGB Charging Dock, giving you effortless battery management coupled with custom chromatic light modes. Under the hood, it is armed with the industry-leading PixArt PAW3395PRO optical flagship sensor, delivering a jaw-dropping resolution scaling up to a staggering 40,000 DPI matrix combined with a blistering flawless tracking speed velocity of 650 IPS and an ultra-responsive 50G acceleration rate framework. Working with self-developed Smart Speed Wireless Technology and outfitted with heavy-duty Omron microswitches rated for an incredible 100-million clicks, this mouse connects seamlessly across Bluetooth, lag-free 2.4GHz wireless, and secure Type-C wired modes.
